coverage: Production Worker backup method validates requests and forwards to the bound repository namespace by object ID.
Actual local Worker rehearsal routes capture/import/status/retirement/release through a service binding; malformed object ID is rejected.
An HTTP POST carrying a Release command does not dispatch private RPC or release the held object.
Connection preflight rejects missing, duplicate, mismatched and cross-environment namespace/bucket metadata, wrong jurisdiction and identical live/archive buckets.
Missing or empty configured API tokens fail before a remote connection opens.
Explicit development dependencies use the already installed runtime and provider SDK versions; the scoped connector owns proxy/runtime disposal.
limits: No remote account connection was opened; remote metadata retrieval, preview upload, RPC and R2 transfer remain unqualified against Cloudflare.
Opening the connector creates a Cloudflare preview proxy and requires an approved operator account and appropriate permissions.
Service binding access to backup conveys administrative authority; no HTTP route is added.
Standalone operator CLI, deployment/writer isolation, production policy and full deployed recovery remain open.
